clara_cs: FYI  small set of EU onboard jobs experienced repeated 502s and long tails between 07:4207:55 UTC. Affected tenants: T-3011, T-3050, T-3078. Want to send a short status + remediation offer.

omar_support: We activated region failover for affected requests at 07:49 UTC, and saw error rate drop ~70%. Logged diagnostics and opened an incident.

vikram_eng: Preliminary cause: a retry storm amplified by a backpressure regression in the batching scheduler. We throttled batch concurrency (cap=5) and restarted workers; hotfix under review. Patch ETA ~2h.

clara_cs: Draft outbound below  please mark edits.

clara_cs: ```Hello <Contact>,

Were reaching out about a transient issue in the EU Dedicated onboarding pipeline on Mar 25, 07:42007:55 UTC that may have delayed onboarding completion for your team. You may have observed higher latency or intermittent 502 errors.

What we did: activated failover to the global standby pool, restarted affected workers, and applied temporary batching throttles.

Offer: were offering a one-time billing credit for compute consumed during retries and a complimentary 30-minute office-hours session to walk through any stalled onboarding work. If youd like, we can also re-run any stalled batches for you.

Next steps: we will publish an RCA within 48 hours and follow up once the permanent fix is deployed. If you have data residency concerns, reply and well coordinate a non-cross-region remediation.

Regards,
Clara (Customer Success) on behalf of Redwood Inference
```

anya_billing: Approved credit wording: "We will apply a one-time credit equivalent to estimated compute for the impacted window, applied to your next invoice." Legal cleared.

omar_support: Ill prepare office-hours slots Mon/Tue 13:00-15:00 UTC and include a diagnostics checklist.

vikram_eng: Add a quick self-help: reduce batch_size to 4 and add retry_backoff ~250ms while we complete the fix. Also note pinned routing to US pool is available in Console > Deployments > Region Failover (contact us first if you have residency constraints).

clara_cs: Nice. I'll localize EN/FR/DE and send shortly. Tagging renewals for T-3050 as high-touch for follow-up.

incident_bot: Incident created: P2 - EU onboarding latency. Lead: vikram_eng.

clara_cs: Sent to contacts for the three tenants. Will post calendar invites and credit confirmations here when done. Thanks all :thumbsup:
